newsitem.title: GERMANY: Netanyahu in Bonn for talks with Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu in Bonn for talks with Kohl.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in Bonn on Thursday for talks with Chancellor Helmut Kohl after deciding to cut short his German visit because of violent clashes in the West Bank and Gaza.
Netanyahu, who made no comment to reporters, flew to the Bonn chancellery by helicopter from Cologne-Bonn airport and was received with military honours.

He had already announced he intended to return home after the meeting with Kohl, in order to deal with mounting violence between Palestinians and Israeli troops in which 20 Arabs and at least two Israeli soldiers have been killed.
Originally Netanyahu had been due to deliver a lecture in Bonn and meet German opposition leaders, parliamentary Speaker Rita Suessmuth and Jewish leader Ignatz Bubis.
